result_text:
I fixed the four default conventions in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/ScopingConventions.java`. I didn't add tests for the new matches, and I didn't check them against sample `.htm`, `.xml` or `-gradle.js` files. The existing `Scoping*` tests in `codeanalyzer` pass.

- **Generated HTML (pkgdown, Doxygen, meta generator):** the path pattern had `html` listed twice. It is now `.*[.](html|htm|xhtml)`, so `.htm` pages match as well.
- **.NET assembly documentation and `// Generated by …` JavaScript:** the patterns `.*/[.]xml` and `.*/[.]js` only matched a file named exactly `.xml` or `.js`. They are now `.*[.]xml` and `.*[.]js`.
- **Gradle JavaScript scripts:** `.*[.][-]gradle[.]js` required a literal `.-gradle.js`. It is now `.*[-]gradle[.]js`, so `build-gradle.js` matches. `build.gradle` still matches through its own rule.

The `<doc>` and `// Generated by` content checks are unchanged, so hand-written `.js` and `.xml` files stay out of the generated scope.
